name: Cinnamon-Bellows Bluff
core_rationale: Ninth warm terracotta spice-drying bluff of Continent 01 where Sola's aromatic hearth-drafts cure cinnamon-bark windbreaks above the eastern orchard rim.
local_conflict: Cinnamon-bark beetles and playful ember-tail foxes nest inside the warm spice-drying flues.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Bakers in Saffron-Press Village say the warm breezes from Cinnamon-Bellows Bluff smell of toasted cinnamon-sugar before every sunrise.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Terraced terracotta spice-towers with curling cinnamon-bark louvers along the eastern basin rim.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What spice-mill sanctuary crowns the warm updrafts of Cinnamon-Bellows Bluff?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-sola-hearth-weaver and scar-kiln-basin along the eastern spice-drying bluffs of Continent 01.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Terraced terracotta spice-towers with curling cinnamon-bark louvers venting warm aromatic drafts.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: spice-mill counter and terrace riser metrics for 1.05m characters will be verified upon promotion to Draft.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: reserved as the ninth District frontier on Continent 01 with zero filler maps.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Provides complete mystery_hook (in_world_rumor, visual_silhouette, unanswered_question) and empty grid_nodes.
